hook_text: A mixer that only runs with the lid down. A van light that comes on from any door. Same switches, different places.
clip_script: Two switches in a row with a lamp. Both must be closed or nothing. That is AND, the safety rule: lid down and button pressed. Truth table: off, off, off, on. Two switches side by side. Either one lights the lamp. That is OR, the alarm rule: any door opens, light on. Table: off, on, on, on. Current is drawn from positive to negative; everyone agreed, so keep the arrows that way. Read the words: both, all, only when means series. Any, either, or means parallel. In your PAT: sensor in series with a night switch for the buzzer, sensor in parallel with a test button for the LED.
visual_style: Whiteboard series switch loop with a four-row table; a parallel switch pair with its table; an arrow from plus to minus; words both/either highlighted; a small PAT sketch.
pacing: Row, AND, table, side by side, OR, table, arrows, words, PAT.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write the truth table for a light with a sensor and a test button.
